objectives.label: Explică situația concretă
criteria: Convey the situation with the essential details in this semantic example: Jeg kan øve mandag eller onsdag. Accept equivalent Norwegian wording and intelligible beginner fragments; never require memorization.
accept: Jeg kan øve mandag eller onsdag.
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

objectives.label: Formulează cererea sau propunerea
criteria: Request or offer the concrete action conveyed by: Vil du øve sammen? A polite equivalent, statement of need or offer is acceptable.
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

objectives.label: Confirmă următorul pas convenit
criteria: After an actual partner reply offering or accepting a feasible next step, confirm that step. A short contextual confirmation is enough. A proposal alone or yes before any plan is not an agreement.
accept: Ja, da gjør vi det slik. (Only after Nora has offered or accepted a concrete permitted next step.)
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
